headline: This law directs the Federal Trade Commission to warn the public about COVID-19 scams and set up a national database of them.
what_it_does: The bill requires the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) to work with other relevant agencies to inform the public about scams related to COVID-19 that come through the mail, by phone calls from telemarketers, or over the internet. The FTC must set up a national database to collect information about these scams. The agency must also share information on how people can report COVID-19-related scams to the right government office.

who_it_affects.how: People can get information about COVID-19-related scams and learn where to report them.

who_it_affects.group: People targeted by mail, phone, or online scams
who_it_affects.how: They gain a central place to find out about these scams and how to report them to the proper agency.
